intent.rationale: The byte export loses data if the 12-bit sample exceeds 255. The file gives no sensor range contract.

labels.note: Assigning twelve-bit a to eight-bit y discards its upper four bits.

settlement.note: The assignment discards a[11:8], but a numerical value is lost only when those unconstrained input bits are nonzero. Simulation confirms both preserving and losing inputs, so the value-dependent convention requires unknown.
